item.title: Underwriting Auction for sale of Government Securities for ₹33,000 crore on November 27, 2026
item.description:
Government of India has announced the sale (re-issue) of Government Securities, as detailed below, through auction to be held on November 27, 2026 (Friday).

As per the extant scheme of underwriting commitment notified on November 14, 2007, the amounts of Minimum Underwriting Commitment (MUC) and the minimum bidding commitment under Additional Competitive Underwriting (ACU) auction, applicable to each Primary Dealer (PD), are as under:

(₹ crore)
Security Notified Amount MUC amount per PD Minimum bidding commitment per PD under ACU auction
6.20% GS 2029 9,000 215 215
6.57% GS 2033 12,000 286 286
7.63% GS 2056 9,000 215 215
7.50% GOI SGrB 2056 3,000 72 72

The underwriting auction will be conducted through multiple price-based method on November 27, 2026 (Friday). PDs may submit their bids for ACU auction electronically through Reserve Bank of India’s Core Banking Solution (e-Kuber system) between 09:00 A.M. and 09:30 A.M. on the day of underwriting auction.

The underwriting commission will be credited to the current account of the respective PDs with RBI on the day of issue of securities.

Ajit Prasad          
Deputy General Manager
(Communications)

item.title: 47th Half-Yearly Report on Management of Foreign Exchange Reserves: April – September 2026
item.description:
It may be recalled that in February 2004, the Reserve Bank initiated the practice of compiling half-yearly reports on the management of foreign exchange reserves and making them public to promote greater transparency and enhance disclosure in the management of the country’s foreign exchange reserves.

In this connection, Reserve Bank of India has today released the 47th Half-Yearly Report on Management of Foreign Exchange Reserves with reference to end-September 2026.

During April-September 2026, India’s foreign exchange reserves increased from US$ 691.11 billion to US$ 737.78 billion. The latest position of India’s foreign exchange reserves is available at the following link:

https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/WSSView.aspx?Id=28849

(Brij Raj)           
Chief General Manager
